latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — diagnose GitHub project health and generate AI reports for Feishu Wiki.

- Analyze GitHub repository issues, code quality, and CI/CD status with a single command.
- Generate a visual health report (including scores, problem lists, and suggestions) published directly to Feishu Wiki.
- Covers five key dimensions: code quality, issue activity, CI/CD, community engagement, and security.
- Supports trigger words and easy input formats for fast team adoption.
- Provides shareable diagnosis cards and full report links for collaboration and documentation.
